name: michizure
description: Michizure（道連れ）— 旅行費用の精算Webサービス

scripts.pretest: node scripts/check-privacy-config.mjs && node scripts/check-wordlist.mjs && node scripts/check-icons.mjs && node scripts/check-public-surface.mjs && node scripts/check-stored-fields.mjs && node scripts/check-pp-rows.mjs && node scripts/check-pp-ui-quotes.mjs
scripts.build:client: rm -f public/app.js public/chunk-*.js && node scripts/build-html.mjs && esbuild src/client/app.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --charset=utf8 --minify --outdir=public --entry-names=app --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] --metafile=.build-meta.json && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.build:shell: node scripts/check-shell-config.mjs && npm run build:client && npx cap sync
